unsupported: Tucs Equipment Inc. operates from Princeton, Minnesota, where founder Marty Tucs and his Food Process Equipment Team have spent 35 years developing solutions for food processing challenges.
The company began as a focused effort to address cooking, chilling, packaging, and handling issues for food service operators and processors.
The business runs an 80,000-square-foot production plant where it designs and builds foodservice and processing equipment.
The company references major world brands alongside small processors as typical clients, with equipment deployed for operators who need integrated cooking, chilling, packaging, and handling lines.
These drivers shape the engineering approach and are presented as the core reasons customers choose the company for processing equipment projects.
